# Content pillar sheet

1 sheet per client. 3 to 5 pillars. Stored in the brain as `social_pillars[]`. Changed only through Gate A.

| Field | Pillar 1 | Pillar 2 | Pillar 3 | Pillar 4 | Pillar 5 |
|-------|----------|----------|----------|----------|----------|
| Name | | | | | |
| What it is (1 sentence) | | | | | |
| Why the audience cares | | | | | |
| Funnel stage (reach / engage / convert) | | | | | |
| Target share of posts (%) — total 100 | | | | | |
| Best formats | | | | | |
| Platforms | | | | | |
| Proof sources (claims, cases, data) | | | | | |
| Example post ideas (3) | | | | | |
| Never do | | | | | |

## Example (B2B software, UK)

| Field | Point of view | Proof | How-to | People | Product |
|-------|---------------|-------|--------|--------|---------|
| Target share | 25% | 25% | 25% | 10% | 15% |
| Stage | reach | convert | engage | reach | convert |
| Best formats | LinkedIn text + image, exec posts | Document carousel, short customer video | Document carousel, short video | Photo, employee posts | Short demo video |
